title: Security evidence orchestration and delegated operator proofkit — SSO/RBAC/KMS acceptance
creator: Aisha Patel
description: PRD addendum to define end-to-end acceptance criteria and a lightweight 'proofkit' for operator/delegated access, SSO/SAML federation, RBAC mappings, audit log schema, and customer KMS/HSM handover evidence. This ticket clarifies scope changes from the parent security PRD: focused artifacts, automated tests, and sign-off owners for Private/VPC deployments to reduce onboarding friction for regulated customers.
acceptance_criteria: SSO/SAML: Successful SAML SP-Initiated and IdP-Initiated flows with three major IdP vendors (Okta, Azure AD, Ping) documented and validated against test IdPs.

SAML metadata: Customer-provided metadata import flow supports entityDescriptor XML validation, fingerprint verification, and failure-mode messages; no manual operator key entry required for basic onboarding.
RBAC: Role mapping matrix defined and enforced end-to-end: roles (admin/operator/viewer) map to infra permissions; automated unit tests validate least-privilege rules for 12 sample scenarios.

Audit logs: Immutable append-only audit stream exported to customer sink (S3/GCS) with schema v1.2, retention policy configurable, and proof-of-existence (hash chain) available for HSM-backed attestations.
KMS/HSM: Customer-managed key wrap/unwrapping flows validated with at least two KMS vendors, and HSM handover checklist for air-gapped/on-prem scenarios completed and signed off.
Evidence bundle: Confluence playbook, automated integration tests, example operator runbook, and a sample onboarding evidence package (PDF) produced for compliance review.
Operational tests: Canary onboarding runbook executed in staging with rollback on failure; SLOs for onboarding time < 4 hours for straightforward cases and < 2 business days for complex cases.
Sign-off: Security lead, Compliance, Legal, Product, and Eng owners listed in signoff_checklist have explicitly approved the evidence bundle.

decisions: Prefer SP-initiated onboarding as default path to reduce friction; IdP-initiated supported but documented as advanced flow.
Audit export: support both push (syslog/HTTP) and pull (cloud object storage) sinks; default to push with signed events for critical activities.
KMS integration pattern: adopt a key-wrapping model by default; direct key import into HSM only for air-gapped installs and requires separate legal attestation.
RBAC mapping: keep three canonical roles (admin/operator/viewer) for 80% of customers and allow custom role extensions via config with gated review.
Keep proofkit lightweight: automated tests + evidence bundle (~10 pages) rather than heavy certification process to accelerate pilot acceptance.
unresolved_questions: How do we standardize retention labels for multi-tenant audit exports when customer wants per-tenant retention in a shared sink?
What is the legal contract language required when customers demand HSM escrow vs self-hosted HSM? Need Legal to provide templated clauses.
Should operator API calls include request-scoped justification notes (free-text) stored in the audit trail? UX tradeoff vs noise in logs.
What encryption envelope metadata must be persisted alongside wrapped keys for future migration between KMS vendors?

risks: Customer-facing onboarding failures increase time-to-first-query and lead to higher support load.
Improper RBAC mapping could lead to privilege escalation in private deployments if not validated.
KMS vendor incompatibility edge-cases may require manual intervention and legal exceptions.
mitigation_plan: Automate metadata validation with clear, user-facing error messages to reduce operator troubleshooting.
Create unit and integration tests that exercise positive/negative RBAC mappings; include fuzz tests for role escalation attempts.
Document vendor-specific KMS adapters and maintain a test harness to validate wrapped key portability.
test_plan: Unit tests: SAML parsing, fingerprint verification, RBAC policy evaluator (coverage > 90%).
Integration tests: End-to-end onboarding for Okta/AzureAD/Ping in staging; audit export verification to S3 sink.
Compliance smoke test: Produce evidence bundle and walkthrough with Compliance reviewer; simulate key-rotation and retrieve audit proof.
